E&O at USD 2,000,000 exceeds the USD 1M fallback floor
cyber at USD 5,000,000 exceeds the USD 2M fallback floor

reasons: The inserted clause is a concise insurance provision for an otherwise absent clause and hits every preferred element: CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, statutory workers' compensation, cyber 5M conditioned on data processing, and certificates on request.
The bankruptcy clause at 14.9 is untouched; the insertion is separately numbered 14.10, so no unrelated commercial term is disturbed and no dangling mechanic is created.

Minor drafting note only: the trigger refers to "Corio or Customer data" rather than a single defined data term, which slightly broadens the cyber trigger in our favour and does not undercut the position.
